{{Quote|People of Tondatha, on the planet of Agamar, in the Lahara sector &hellip; You have been found guilty of sedition against the Empire, and of plotting against the great Emperor Palpatine. Your punishment will be imposed without delay.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial commander]] pronounces sentence on Tondatha|<ref name="XWTOSG" />}}
Early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''destroyed''' the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Tondatha]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] in retaliation for the alleged sedition of its residents. The parents of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] were among those [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack.<ref name="XWTOSG" />
